reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 80,750.0 - UNCHANGED for the fourth consecutive file. The level has now been tested and held: the 01:00 UTC bar wicked to 80,857.6, stopping 107.6 points short, and every 1H bar since has closed above 81,318.5. Spot sits 807.6 points above the gate, 1.98 times the 407.85-point 1H ATR14, which is the widest cushion this gate has carried since it was set. A level that has been probed and rejected is worth more than one that has never been tested, so it stands unmoved.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 82,099.0 - UNCHANGED. 82,099.0 is the 24h high and it is now a TWICE-rejected lid: the 01:00 UTC bar printed exactly 82,099.0 and closed 80,993.3, a 1,105.7-point upper wick. It is also the price point of the unresolved regular bearish RSI divergence on the 1H, re-verified independently this session - 82,099.0 at RSI 50.92 against 81,953.1 at RSI 73.19 thirty-four hours earlier. A settled close above it clears the lid and kills the divergence in one move. The last settled 1H close was 81,639.0 at 06:00 UTC, 460.0 points short, so it has NOT fired.

decisionBox.changed: Bias stays BULLISH with a bullish tilt, and unlike the 00:10 run this one has real new information to price. Probabilities move 48/33/19 to 53/32/15 and confidence 5.90 to 6.40, and three verified facts pay for that. FIRST and most important, the liquidation tape has INVERTED. Two hours ago the endday file measured 670,192 USD of long liquidations against 90,973 USD of shorts, a 7.4-to-1 tilt against longs, and argued that the long weight was historical. That call was right: the rolling 100-fill window now spans 02:19 to 06:45 UTC, the old flush has aged out of it, and the tape reads 189,432 USD of SHORT liquidations against 65,545 USD of longs - a 2.9-to-1 tilt the other way, with the single largest bucket 109,762 USD of forced buying at 81,750, above spot. SECOND, open interest ROSE 1.02 percent from 2,465,909,774 to 2,491,054,777 USD while that was happening, so positions are being added into short-side pain rather than simply evicted. THIRD, the 1H series has built higher lows into the lid - 80,857.6, then 80,951.0, 81,234.6, 81,312.9, 81,400.0 - with every close back above the 1H EMA20 at 81,226.5. Against that, two things cap the upside and are why this is 53 and not 60: the 4H MACD histogram is NEGATIVE at minus 30.32 with 4H RSI at 69.51, so momentum is cooling at the highs, and 82,099.0 has now rejected twice. Position moves HOLD to ADD, and the size is deliberately small - 15 USDT, not the 20 the midday session used - because this is a buy in the upper third of a three-day flag rather than at support.

liquidation.note: 109,762 USD of SHORT liquidations - forced buying - cleared in this 250-point bucket over the 02:19 to 06:45 UTC window. It is the largest single bucket on the tape and the only meaningful weight above spot, 192.4 points up. Honest scale caveat: 110k USD is small in absolute terms, one venue only, and it is REALIZED fill data rather than a forward resting-order map, so read it as evidence of where shorts are hurting, not as a guaranteed draw.

Two-way bucket and the pivot of the overnight chop: 78,003 USD of short liquidations and 53,513 USD of long liquidations both cleared here, 57.6 points under spot. Fills on both sides in the same band means the level is being fought over rather than defended.
13,699 USD total, 12,032 of it long fills. Thin, and it sits just under the 1H EMA20 at 81,226.5 - a shelf rather than a magnet.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP, and this session it is cleaner than it has been. The endday file argued the downside magnet was spent and the upside pressure was live; two hours later the rolling window has confirmed it by arithmetic rather than by interpretation. The flush weight below has aged out of the sample entirely and what remains is 189,432 USD of short pain against 65,545 USD of long pain, concentrated at 81,750 above spot. nearestAbove is the 81,750 cluster 192.4 points up; nearestBelow is the contested 81,500 band 57.6 points down. The caveat that matters: total realized liquidations across the whole 4.4-hour window are only about 255,000 USD on OKX, which is a quiet tape. A quiet tape means these magnets are weak, and 192 points is close enough that the cluster may simply be absorbed. This is a lean, not a squeeze thesis.

calibration.note: Graded against YESTERDAY's 2026-09-20 endday file, per the midnight protocol. That file published at 81,398.9 with reduce 80,750.0 and add 82,099.0. NEITHER GATE FIRED in the window: the low since was 81,300.3 on the Bogota clock - 550.3 points of clearance over the reduce gate - and the highest settled 1H close was 81,639.0, some 460.0 points short of the add gate. The endday's two substantive calls both graded WELL. It set NO resting stop and argued the 80,750.0 gate would not be reached in a sub-two-hour window; price never came within 400 points of it, so the decision saved a stop that would have been decoration. And it called the liquidation tape as having 'changed side under the surface', with stale long pain below and live short pain above; two hours later the rolling window has flipped from 7.4-to-1 against longs to 2.9-to-1 against shorts, which is the forecast confirmed by arithmetic. acting_helped is TRUE but the magnitude is small - the endday held a 0.00201531 BTC spot core through a 158.7-point rise, worth plus 0.32 USDT. The real credit is the stop decision, which is unmeasurable in PnL and would have been expensive to get wrong.
